dialogue.content: こんばんは、スタンバイしています。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm ready when you are. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願い致します。いつでも🆗ですよ。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'm ready anytime.

dialogue.content: はい、では、始めさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Okay, then let's begin.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's a pleasure to speak with you.

dialogue.content: お願い致します。
dialogue.English: Likewise, thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日はご相談にお越し頂きありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.content: 初めにご年齢と性別、ご相談の中でなんとお呼びしたら良いかを、教えて下さい。
dialogue.English: To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and how you would like me to address you during our session?

dialogue.content: 30代男性です。つばさでお願いします。
dialogue.English: I'm a man in my 30s. Please call me Tsubasa.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。それでは、つばささん、今日はどの様なご相談でお越し頂きましたか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. So, Tsubasa, what brings you in for a consultation today?

dialogue.content: 子供についての相談です。
dialogue.English: It's about my child.

dialogue.content: はい、ご自分の子供さんについてのご相談で良いですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So this is about your own child, is that correct?

dialogue.content: そうです。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right. Thank you.

dialogue.content: では、もう少し詳しく、どの様なことなのかを、教えてください。
dialogue.English: Then, could you please tell me a little more about it in detail?

dialogue.content: はい。中1の息子がいます。プロのサッカー選手を目指しているらしいのですが、行動が伴ってないんですよね
dialogue.English: Yes. I have a son in his first year of junior high school. He says he wants to be a professional soccer player, but his actions don't match his ambition.

dialogue.content: 息子さんはプロのサッカー選手志望なのですね、たくましい感じがします。
dialogue.English: So he aspires to be a professional soccer player—that’s quite an ambitious goal.

dialogue.content: いや、身体は細くて小さくて困ってます
dialogue.English: No, actually, I'm concerned because he's thin and small.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、サッカー選手にはまだ体が追いついていない？そこがご心配ですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So his body hasn't quite caught up yet for a soccer player? Is that what you're worried about?

dialogue.content: 身体はこれからかなと思ってます。でも行動が伴っていないんです。
dialogue.English: I think his body will develop over time. But his actions don't match his ambitions.

dialogue.content: そこがご心配なところなのですね。
dialogue.English: So that's what you're concerned about.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: これからの夢を応援したいのに、これじゃダメだよと思っておられる？
dialogue.English: You want to support his future dream, but you're thinking, 'This isn't going to work'?

dialogue.content: そうですね。夢は応援したいです。ただ、その行動で大丈夫なの？って感じです
dialogue.English: That's right. I want to support his dream. It's just that I feel like, 'Is he really going to be okay with these actions?'

dialogue.content: その行動というのは、具体的にどの様なことですか？
dialogue.English: What kind of actions are you referring to, specifically?

dialogue.content: とりあえず、優先順位がスマホですね笑
dialogue.English: Well, for starters, his top priority is his smartphone. (laughs)

dialogue.content: 親も悪いですが
dialogue.English: Though I'm at fault as a parent, too.

dialogue.content: スマホが一番じゃ無いだろうと、、親も悪いという音は？どういうことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You feel his smartphone shouldn't be his top priority... and what do you mean when you say it's your fault as a parent?

dialogue.content: 音はは事は、ですごめんなさい
dialogue.English: My apologies, I misspoke.

dialogue.content: 親である私がスマホを持たせてる訳なので、そこに責任感じています。ということです。
dialogue.English: I mean, since I'm the parent who gave him the smartphone, I feel responsible for that.

dialogue.content: スマホを持たせておいて、やるなは無いだろうと自己反省しておられるのですね、でも、今時、取り上げることもちょっと出来にくいと、
dialogue.English: I see, so you're reflecting on how it's not fair to tell him not to use it after having given it to him. But at the same time, it's difficult to just take it away these days.

dialogue.content: そうですね。というか、プロになる人って、取り上げるとかなくてもプロ選手になりたくて行動しますよね？
dialogue.English: That's right. I mean, people who become pros act on their desire to become a pro player without anyone having to take things away from them, right?

dialogue.content: どうなんでしょうね、一途にやってくれたらすごいと思いますよね。
dialogue.English: I wonder about that. It would be amazing if he were completely devoted to it, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: でも、人によりけりで、使い方を考えている人もいるのでは無いでしょうか？
dialogue.English: But it probably depends on the person. Maybe some people are more thoughtful about how they use their time?

dialogue.content: １にスマホで、２にはサッカーになっていますか？
dialogue.English: Is it smartphone first and soccer second?

dialogue.content: まあ、2番はサッカーなのかな？とは思います。
dialogue.English: Well, I think soccer is probably number two.

dialogue.content: そこは、しっかりサッカーなのですね。
dialogue.English: So soccer is firmly in that spot, then.

dialogue.content: まず、スマホを持った時、親御さんとしては、どうなさるのですか？
dialogue.English: First, when he's on his smartphone, what do you do as a parent?

dialogue.content: 叱ったりしますか？
dialogue.English: Do you scold him?

dialogue.content: 隠れてしてますね。見つかると隠す感じです。ある程度は許してますが、使用時間が長いと怒ります。「それでプロ目指してるの？」って感じです
dialogue.English: He uses it in secret. When he's found out, he tries to hide it. I allow it to some extent, but I get angry when he's on it for too long. I'll say something like, 'And you're aiming to be a pro with that attitude?'

dialogue.content: お父様もサッカーがお好きですか？
dialogue.English: Do you like soccer yourself?

dialogue.content: はい。ずっとしています。
dialogue.English: Yes. I’ve been playing for a long time.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。親子でサッカーができるなんて素敵ですね。
dialogue.English: I see. It's wonderful that you can play soccer together as father and son.

dialogue.content: プロレベルでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you at a professional level?

dialogue.content: それは嬉しいです。私は全然、中途半端にやってきましたから。息子には本気でやってほしくて。
dialogue.English: That's nice to hear. As for me, I never really took it seriously. That's why I want my son to be serious about it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、サッカー愛と、息子愛のコラボレーションですね、
dialogue.English: I see, so it's a combination of your love for soccer and your love for your son.

dialogue.content: 羨ましい限りです
dialogue.English: I’m truly envious.

dialogue.content: 息子愛ありますかね？
dialogue.English: Is it really love for my son, I wonder?

dialogue.content: あれ、これじゃダメだと思うのは、上手くなって欲しいと願っていらっしゃる。気になるからだと思いますが、違いますか？
dialogue.English: Well, the reason you think 'this isn't going to work' is because you want him to get better. I believe it's because you care about him, am I wrong?

dialogue.content: まさに、そうですね笑
dialogue.English: That's exactly it. (laughs)

dialogue.content: それで、つい、厳しくなる。気にならない存在なら、そんなこと思わないと感じました。
dialogue.English: And that's why you end up being strict. If you didn't care about him, I feel you wouldn't think that way.

dialogue.content: 一緒に練習なさるのですか？
dialogue.English: Do you practice together?

dialogue.content: そうですね。図星ですね。たまに練習します。毎日のように調子を聞きます。息子とボール蹴るのは最高ですね！
dialogue.English: Yes. You've hit the nail on the head. We practice sometimes. I ask him how he's doing almost every day. Kicking a ball around with my son is the best!

dialogue.content: 羨ましいです。親子の姿が、浮かびます。息子さんもお幸せですね。
dialogue.English: I'm envious. I can picture you two together. Your son is very fortunate.

dialogue.content: スマホは、お父様もかなり、なさる？
dialogue.English: Do you use your smartphone quite a bit yourself?

dialogue.content: そうなんですかね？厳しいと思ってると思いますよ。スマホ触りますね。
dialogue.English: Is that so? I think he probably sees me as strict. Yes, I do use my smartphone.

dialogue.content: お父様は、サッカーを中途半端になさって来たとおっしゃいましたが、中一の息子さんを指導できるくらいだから厳しくもできるのだと思いますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned that you played soccer half-heartedly, but since you're able to coach your first-year junior high son, I imagine you can be strict with him. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね。夢を叶えて欲しいあまり厳しくなってしまうのかな
dialogue.English: That's true. I guess I become too strict because I want him to achieve his dream so badly.

dialogue.content: 息子さんは、自分より上手なお父様を尊敬しているのでは無いでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Perhaps your son respects you for being better at soccer than he is?

dialogue.content: どうでしょうかね〜？
dialogue.English: I wonder about that...

dialogue.content: ひょっとして、お父様の真似をしたいかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: Perhaps he wants to imitate you.

dialogue.content: スマホをやって、サッカーをやる(笑）
dialogue.English: Use the smartphone, then play soccer. (laughs)

dialogue.content: なるほど笑そうかもしれませんね！
dialogue.English: I see. (laughs) You might be right!

dialogue.content: サッカーが上手くなる方法について、話し合った事はおありですか？
dialogue.English: Have you ever talked with him about how to get better at soccer?

dialogue.content: ほぼ毎日ですね笑
dialogue.English: Almost every day. (laughs)

dialogue.content: 毎日話し合えるのですね
dialogue.English: So you’re able to discuss it every day.

dialogue.content: それって素晴らしいことだと感じます。
dialogue.English: I think that’s wonderful.

dialogue.content: そうなんですかね？
dialogue.English: You think so?

dialogue.content: 男同士の話し合い
dialogue.English: Man-to-man talks.

dialogue.content: サッカーあればこそでしょうか
dialogue.English: Perhaps it's all thanks to soccer.

dialogue.content: 例えば、どんな内容なのですか？
dialogue.English: For example, what kinds of things do you discuss?

dialogue.content: 今日の良かったとこは？どこがダメだった？んじゃ次はこうしたら？みたいな感じですね。
dialogue.English: It's like, 'What did you do well today? What went wrong? So, how about trying this next time?'

dialogue.content: なるほど、体が細くて小さいとのことですが、体力づくりとかは？
dialogue.English: I see. You mentioned he's thin and small. What about building up his physical strength?

dialogue.content: 夫婦で食事には気をつけてます。プロテインとかも取るようにしてますね。
dialogue.English: My wife and I are careful about his diet. We also make sure he takes protein.

dialogue.content: さすがですね、プロテインで良い筋肉づくりですね！
dialogue.English: That's impressive. Building good muscle with protein!

dialogue.content: 良かったところは、たくさん褒めてあげていますか？
dialogue.English: Do you praise him a lot for the things he does well?

dialogue.content: そうですね。なるべくそうしてます。でも、やり過ぎスマホは怒ります。
dialogue.English: Yes, I try to do that as much as possible. But I do get angry about his excessive smartphone use.

dialogue.content: スマホは、お父様も少し控えめになさるという事で、見本を示すというのはいかがですか？
dialogue.English: What if you were to set an example by using your own smartphone a little less?

dialogue.content: はい。そうします笑
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll do that. (laughs)

dialogue.content: そして出来たらまたうんと褒めてあげる。
dialogue.English: And when he does, praise him a lot again.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: プロになりたいサッカー選手の新人さんにする、大切なことを聞いた事があります。
dialogue.English: I've heard about something important to do for rookies who want to become professional soccer players.

dialogue.content: それは、プロとして扱ってあげる事だそうです。
dialogue.English: It's to treat them like a professional.

dialogue.content: 教えていただきたいです
dialogue.English: I’d like to hear more about that.

dialogue.content: なるほど！
dialogue.English: I see!

dialogue.content: 卵でも、志があるなら、プロとして扱う。
dialogue.English: Even if they're still developing, if they have the ambition, you treat them like a pro.

dialogue.content: 扱われた人間に、人はなっていくのだという教え方です。
dialogue.English: It’s the idea that people grow into the way they are treated.

dialogue.content: 栄養のことを伺って、ご夫妻で応援なさっているのだなと思いました。
dialogue.English: Hearing about his nutrition, I realized that you and your wife are supporting him together.

dialogue.content: なるほど！良い事を聞けました。
dialogue.English: I see! That's very helpful to hear.

dialogue.content: 夢に対しては応援します。
dialogue.English: We will support his dream.

dialogue.content: そんな中で、ご本人もやらねばという気持ち、いっぱいだと思います。
dialogue.English: In that environment, I'm sure he himself feels a strong sense of 'I have to do this.'

dialogue.content: でも、逃げたくなること、ちょっと後回しにしたくなる事は、人間、誰でもある事ですよね。
dialogue.English: But wanting to run away or procrastinate a little is something everyone feels, isn't it?

dialogue.content: それは普通のこと、当たり前のことだと思うのです。
dialogue.English: I think that's a normal, natural thing.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そんな時に、プロとして扱ってくださるお父様がいらしたら、だんだん、一番はスマホではなく、一番はサッカーになるのでは無いかと思いますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: At times like that, if he has a father who treats him like a professional, I think his priority might gradually shift from his smartphone to soccer. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね。新しい発見ができました。ありがとうございます😭
dialogue.English: You're right. That's a new discovery for me. Thank you. 😭

dialogue.content: 良かったです
dialogue.English: I’m glad to hear that.

dialogue.content: では、そろそろご相談を終えたいと思いますが、大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Well then, I'd like to wrap up our session soon, is that alright with you?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です。新しい気付きをありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine. Thank you for the new insights.

dialogue.content: 夢を追いかけることが、そんな時を過ごす事が、将来の息子さんを大きな人間に育てると思います。
dialogue.English: I believe that pursuing a dream and going through times like these will help your son grow into a person of great character.

dialogue.content: それをご夫妻で応援なさる姿を思い描くと、私も幸せになります。
dialogue.English: Imagining you and your wife supporting him together makes me happy as well.

dialogue.content: サッカーを楽しんでください。
dialogue.English: Please enjoy soccer together.

dialogue.content: そうですね。そうなるように応援していきたいと思います。
dialogue.English: You're right. I want to continue supporting him so it turns out that way.

dialogue.content: 親子で楽しみます
dialogue.English: We will enjoy it together as father and son.

dialogue.content: またご相談してみたいと思われた時には、気軽に来ていただけたら嬉しいです。
dialogue.English: If you ever feel like you'd like to talk again, please don't hesitate to reach out.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました。それではカウンセリングを終了致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today. This concludes our counseling session.

dialogue.content: はい。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: ロールプレイ終了させていただきます。
dialogue.English: This concludes the role-play.

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.English: You too, thank you.
